---
api_platform:
    title: Hello API Platform
    version: 1.0.0
    defaults:
        stateless: true
        cache_headers:
            vary: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization', 'Origin']
doctrine:
    dbal:
        url: '%env(resolve:DATABASE_URL)%'

        # IMPORTANT: You MUST configure your server version,
        # either here or in the DATABASE_URL env var (see .env file)
        #server_version: '16'

        profiling_collect_backtrace: '%kernel.debug%'
    orm:
        validate_xml_mapping: true
        naming_strategy: doctrine.orm.naming_strategy.underscore
        identity_generation_preferences:
            Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\PostgreSQLPlatform: identity
        auto_mapping: true
        mappings:
            App:
                type: attribute
                is_bundle: false
                dir: '%kernel.project_dir%/src/Entity'
                prefix: 'App\Entity'
                alias: App

when@test:
    doctrine:
        dbal:
            # "TEST_TOKEN" is typically set by ParaTest
            dbname_suffix: '_test%env(default::TEST_TOKEN)%'

when@prod:
    doctrine:
        orm:
            query_cache_driver:
                type: pool
                pool: doctrine.system_cache_pool
            result_cache_driver:
                type: pool
                pool: doctrine.result_cache_pool

    framework:
        cache:
            pools:
                doctrine.result_cache_pool:
                    adapter: cache.app
                doctrine.system_cache_pool:
                    adapter: cache.system
api_platform:
    resource: .
    type: api_platform
    prefix: /api
security:
    # https://symfony.com/doc/current/security.html#registering-the-user-hashing-passwords
    password_hashers:
        Symfony\Component\Security\Core\User\PasswordAuthenticatedUserInterface: 'auto'

    # https://symfony.com/doc/current/security.html#loading-the-user-the-user-provider
    providers:
        users_in_memory: { memory: null }

    firewalls:
        dev:
            # Ensure dev tools and static assets are always allowed
            pattern: ^/(_profiler|_wdt|assets|build)/
            security: false
        main:
            lazy: true
            provider: users_in_memory

            # Activate different ways to authenticate:
            # https://symfony.com/doc/current/security.html#the-firewall

            # https://symfony.com/doc/current/security/impersonating_user.html
            # switch_user: true

    # Note: Only the *first* matching rule is applied
    access_control:
        # - { path: ^/admin, roles: ROLE_ADMIN }
        # - { path: ^/profile, roles: ROLE_USER }

when@test:
    security:
        password_hashers:
            # Password hashers are resource-intensive by design to ensure security.
            # In tests, it's safe to reduce their cost to improve performance.
            Symfony\Component\Security\Core\User\PasswordAuthenticatedUserInterface:
                algorithm: auto
                cost: 4 # Lowest possible value for bcrypt
                time_cost: 3 # Lowest possible value for argon
                memory_cost: 10 # Lowest possible value for argon
nelmio_cors:
    defaults:
        origin_regex: true
        allow_origin: ['%env(CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN)%']
        allow_methods: ['GET', 'OPTIONS', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']
        allow_headers: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization']
        expose_headers: ['Link']
        max_age: 3600
    paths:
        '^/': null
---

services:
###> doctrine/doctrine-bundle ###
  database:
    image: postgres:${POSTGRES_VERSION:-16}-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-app}
      # You should definitely change the password in production
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-!ChangeMe!}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-app}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-d", "${POSTGRES_DB:-app}", "-U", "${POSTGRES_USER:-app}"]
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 60s
    volumes:
      - database_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data:rw
      # You may use a bind-mounted host directory instead, so that it is harder to accidentally remove the volume and lose all your data!

  database_data:

<?php

/*

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ApiPlatform\JsonApi\State;

use ApiPlatform\JsonApi\Util\ResourceLinkageResolver;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Property\Factory\PropertyMetadataFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Property\Factory\PropertyNameCollectionFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Resource\Factory\ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use ApiPlatform\State\Util\RequestParser;

final class JsonApiProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ProviderInterface $decorated,
        private readonly PropertyNameCollectionFactoryInterface $propertyNameCollectionFactory,
        private readonly PropertyMetadataFactoryInterface $propertyMetadataFactory,
        private readonly ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface $resourceMetadataCollectionFactory,
        private readonly ResourceLinkageResolver $resourceLinkageResolver,
        private readonly string $orderParameterName = 'order',
    ) {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object|array|null
    {
        $request = $context['request'] ?? null;

        if (!$request || 'jsonapi' !== $request->getRequestFormat()) {
            return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
        }

        $filters = $request->attributes->get('_api_filters', []);
        $queryParameters = $request->query->all();
        $orderParameter = $queryParameters['sort'] ?? null;

        if (
            null !== $orderParameter
            && !\is_array($orderParameter)
        ) {
            $orderParametersArray = explode(',', (string) $orderParameter);
            $transformedOrderParametersArray = [];

            foreach ($orderParametersArray as $orderParameter) {
                $sorting = 'asc';

                if ('-' === ($orderParameter[0] ?? null)) {
                    $sorting = 'desc';
                    $orderParameter = substr($orderParameter, 1);
                }

                $transformedOrderParametersArray[$orderParameter] = $sorting;
            }

            $filters[$this->orderParameterName] = $transformedOrderParametersArray;
        }

        $filterParameter = $queryParameters['filter'] ?? null;
        if (
            $filterParameter
            && \is_array($filterParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($filterParameter, $filters);
        }

        $pageParameter = $queryParameters['page'] ?? null;
        if (
            \is_array($pageParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($pageParameter, $filters);
        }

        foreach (['page', 'itemsPerPage', 'pagination', 'partial'] as $paginationParameter) {
            if (isset($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !\is_array($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !isset($filters[$paginationParameter])) {
                $filters[$paginationParameter] = $queryParameters[$paginationParameter];
            }
        }

        [$included, $properties] = $this->transformFieldsetsParameters($queryParameters, $operation);

        if ($properties) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_filter_property', $properties);
        }

        if ($included) {

    public function normalize(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array
    {
        $violations = [];
        foreach ($data as $violation) {
            $violations[] = [
                'detail' => $violation->getMessage(),
                'source' => [
                    'pointer' => $this->getSourcePointerFromViolation($violation),
                ],
            ];
        }

        return ['errors' => $violations];
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return self::FORMAT === $format && $data instanceof ConstraintViolationListInterface;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return self::FORMAT === $format ? [ConstraintViolationListInterface::class => true] : [];
    }

    private function getSourcePointerFromViolation(ConstraintViolationInterface $violation): string
    {
        $fieldName = $violation->getPropertyPath();

        if (!$fieldName) {
            return 'data';
        }

        $root = $violation->getRoot();

        if (!\is_object($root)) {
            return "data/attributes/$fieldName";
        }

        $class = $root::class;
        $propertyMetadata = $this->propertyMetadataFactory
            ->create(
                // Im quite sure this requires some thought in case of validations over relationships
                $class,
                $fieldName
            );

        if (null !== $this->nameConverter) {
            $fieldName = $this->nameConverter->normalize($fieldName, $class, self::FORMAT);
        }

        if ($propertyMetadata->getNativeType()?->isSatisfiedBy(static fn ($t) => $t instanceof ObjectType)) {
            return "data/relationships/$fieldName";
        }

        return "data/attributes/$fieldName";
    }
}

The payment service answers 404 to GET, so I'll exercise its POST endpoint directly once the code exists. The DB collation is `en_US.utf8`, and I'll use the database's default ordering for title sorts.

I have what I need for the design:
- JSON:API format from the package, with `page[number]`/`page[size]` as the pagination parameter names.
- Custom providers that build the list queries and validate the spec's query parameters (400 `source.parameter`).
- A processor for purchases (lock, check stock, call the payment service, then store in one transaction).
- A kernel listener for the `Customer-Id` check (401 before anything else) and an exception listener that renders the spec's error document.

I'll add the HTTP client for the payment call, then write the configuration.

# Serves the bookshop API on http://localhost:8089, in the foreground.

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

export APP_ENV=prod
export APP_DEBUG=0
export APP_SECRET="${APP_SECRET:-bookshop-eval-secret}"
export DATABASE_URL='postgresql://eval_rw:eval_rw@postgres:5432/llmapi_eval?serverVersion=17&charset=utf8'

php bin/console cache:clear --no-interaction

exec php -d variables_order=EGPCS -S 0.0.0.0:8089 -t public public/index.php

content.text:
Two real issues:

1. **Pagination links duplicate `page[number]`.** The request's nested `page` array isn't removed by the normalizer's link builder, so the URL carries two values. Since `CollectionNormalizer` is final, I'll decorate it with a small normalizer that writes the links itself.
2. **`_id` attribute.** I'll check how the JSON:API item normalizer decides which properties are attributes.

input.command: cd /work/vendor/api-platform/json-api/Serializer; sed -n 189,197p ItemNormalizer.php; sed -n 249,262p ItemNormalizer.php; grep -n "_id\|reserved\|Reserved" ItemNormalizer.php ItemNormalizerTrait.php ReservedAttributeNameConverter.php | head -20
input.description: Inspect how identifiers become attributes in JSON:API

content.text: `_id` comes from the identifier property being treated as an ordinary readable attribute. I'll try marking `id` as not readable, which should keep the top-level `id` (taken from the identifier) and drop the attribute.

input.command: cd /work/src/Entity && for f in Author.php Book.php Purchase.php; do sed -i 's|^    #\[ORM\\Id\]$|    #[ApiProperty(readable: false, writable: false)]\n    #[ORM\\Id]|' $f; done; grep -n "ApiProperty" Author.php Book.php Purchase.php | head; sed -i 's|^use ApiPlatform\\Metadata\\ApiResource;|use ApiPlatform\\Metadata\\ApiProperty;\nuse ApiPlatform\\Metadata\\ApiResource;|' Author.php; grep -n "^use ApiPlatform" Author.php; sleep 0; cd /work && pkill -f "php -d variables_order=EGPCS -S" ; sleep 1; (./start.sh > /tmp/api.log 2>&1 &); sleep 5; curl -g -s -m 10 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.api+json' 'http://127.0.0.1:8089/books?page[size]=1' | head -c 400; echo; curl -g -s -m 10 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.api+json' 'http://127.0.0.1:8089/authors/2?include=books' | head -c 900

<?php

namespace App\OpenApi;

use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Completes the generated OpenAPI document with what the resources cannot
 * declare on their own: the JSON:API query parameters, the Customer-Id header
 * and the error responses of each operation.
 */
final class DocumentNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface
{
    private const JSON_API = 'application/vnd.api+json';

    public function __construct(private readonly NormalizerInterface $inner)
    {
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array|string|int|float|bool|\ArrayObject|null
    {
        $document = $this->inner->normalize($data, $format, $context);
        if (!\is_array($document)) {
            return $document;
        }

        $document['components']['schemas']['JsonApiErrors'] = self::errorsSchema();

        foreach (self::operations() as $path => $methods) {
            foreach ($methods as $method => $addition) {
                if (!isset($document['paths'][$path][$method])) {
                    continue;
                }

                $operation = $document['paths'][$path][$method];
                $operation['parameters'] = self::mergeParameters($operation['parameters'] ?? [], $addition['parameters'] ?? []);
                foreach ($addition['responses'] ?? [] as $status => $response) {
                    $operation['responses'][$status] = $response;
                }
                $document['paths'][$path][$method] = $operation;
            }
        }

        return $document;
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $generated
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $added
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private static function mergeParameters(array $generated, array $added): array
    {
        $names = array_map(static fn (array $parameter): string => $parameter['in'].':'.$parameter['name'], $added);
        $kept = array_values(array_filter(
            $generated,
            static fn (array $parameter): bool => !\in_array($parameter['in'].':'.$parameter['name'], $names, true),
        ));

        return array_values(array_merge($kept, $added));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function errorsSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'object',
            'required' => ['errors'],
            'properties' => [
                'errors' => [
                    'type' => 'array',
                    'items' => [
                        'type' => 'object',
                        'required' => ['status', 'title', 'detail'],
                        'properties' => [
                            'status' => ['type' => 'string', 'example' => '422'],
                            'title' => ['type' => 'string'],
                            'detail' => ['type' => 'string'],
                            'source' => [
                                'type' => 'object',
                                'properties' => [
                                    'pointer' => ['type' => 'string', 'example' => '/data/attributes/priceCents'],
                                    'parameter' => ['type' => 'string', 'example' => 'sort'],
                                ],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>

    private static function error(string $description): array
    {
        return [
            'description' => $description,
            'content' => [self::JSON_API => ['schema' => ['$ref' => '#/components/schemas/JsonApiErrors']]],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function query(string $name, string $description, array $schema = ['type' => 'string']): array
    {
        return ['name' => $name, 'in' => 'query', 'description' => $description, 'required' => false, 'schema' => $schema];
    }

namespace App\State;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProcessorInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Validator\Exception\ValidationException;
use App\ApiResource\PurchaseInput;
use App\Entity\Book;
use App\Entity\Customer;
use App\Entity\Purchase;
use App\EventListener\CustomerIdentificationListener;
use App\Payment\PaymentGateway;
use Doctrine\DBAL\LockMode;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\ConflictHttpException;
use Symfony\Component\Validator\ConstraintViolation;
use Symfony\Component\Validator\ConstraintViolationList;

/**
 * Buys books: checks the lines, locks the books, takes the payment and stores
 * the purchase and the new stock in one transaction. Any failure stores nothing.
 *
 * @implements ProcessorInterface<PurchaseInput, Purchase>
 */
final class PurchaseProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $entityManager,
        private readonly PaymentGateway $paymentGateway,
    ) {
    }

    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Purchase
    {
        $request = $context['request'];
        $customerId = (int) $request->attributes->get(CustomerIdentificationListener::ATTRIBUTE);
        $lines = $this->validShape($data->lines);

        return $this->entityManager->wrapInTransaction(function () use ($lines, $customerId): Purchase {
            $books = $this->lockBooks($lines);

            $quantities = [];
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $quantities[$line['bookId']] = ($quantities[$line['bookId']] ?? 0) + $line['quantity'];
            }
            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                if ($books[$bookId]->getStock() < $quantity) {
                    throw new ConflictHttpException(\sprintf('There is not enough stock of book %d.', $bookId));
                }
            }

            $total = 0;
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $total += $line['quantity'] * $books[$line['bookId']]->getPriceCents();
            }

            $this->paymentGateway->charge($customerId, $total);

            /** @var Customer $customer */
            $customer = $this->entityManager->getReference(Customer::class, $customerId);
            $purchase = new Purchase($customer, new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC')), $total);
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $book = $books[$line['bookId']];
                $purchase->addLine($book, $line['quantity']);
                $book->decreaseStock($line['quantity']);
            }

            $this->entityManager->persist($purchase);
            $this->entityManager->flush();

            return $purchase;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param mixed $lines the lines as sent
     *
     * @return list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}>
     */
    private function validShape(mixed $lines): array
    {
        $violations = [];
        if (!\is_array($lines) || [] === $lines) {
            $violations[] = $this->violation('lines', 'At least one line is required.');
        } else {
            foreach (array_values($lines) as $index => $line) {
                $path = \sprintf('lines[%d]', $index);
                if (!\is_array($line)) {
                    $violations[] = $this->violation($path, 'Each line must be an object with a bookId and a quantity.');
                    continue;
                }
                if (!\is_int($line['bookId'] ?? null)) {
                    $violations[] = $this->violation($path.'.bookId', 'The bookId must be an integer.');
                }
                if (!\is_int($line['quantity'] ?? null) || $line['quantity'] < 1) {
                    $violations[] = $this->violation($path.'.quantity', 'The quantity must be an integer of at least 1.');
                }
            }
        }

        if ([] !== $violations) {
            throw new ValidationException(new ConstraintViolationList($violations));
        }

        return array_values($lines);
    }

    /**
     * Locks the books of the lines, which must all exist and be published.
     *
     * @param list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}> $lines
     *
     * @return array<int, Book> the books by id
     */
    private function lockBooks(array $lines): array
    {
        $books = [];
        $violations = [];
        foreach ($lines as $index => $line) {
            $book = $this->entityManager->find(Book::class, $line['bookId'], LockMode::PESSIMISTIC_WRITE);
            if (null === $book || !$book->isPublished()) {
                $violations[] = $this->violation(\sprintf('lines[%d].bookId', $index), 'The book must exist and be published.');
                continue;
            }
            $books[$line['bookId']] = $book;
        }

        if ([] !== $violations) {
            throw new ValidationException(new ConstraintViolationList($violations));
        }

        return $books;
    }

    private function violation(string $path, string $message): ConstraintViolation
    {
        return new ConstraintViolation($message, null, [], null, $path, null);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;

/**
 * Reads and validates the JSON:API query parameters the resources understand.
 * Anything malformed raises a QueryParameterException (400).
 */
final class Query
{
    public const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 10;
    public const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    public const MAX_PAGE_NUMBER = 2147483647;

    /**
     * @return array{int, int} the page number (from 1) and the page size
     */
    public static function pagination(Request $request): array
    {
        $page = self::family($request, 'page');

        $number = self::integer($page, 'number', 'page[number]') ?? 1;
        if ($number < 1 || $number > self::MAX_PAGE_NUMBER) {
            throw new QueryParameterException('page[number]', 'The page number must be an integer from 1.');
        }

        $size = self::integer($page, 'size', 'page[size]') ?? self::DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
        if ($size < 1 || $size > self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
            throw new QueryParameterException('page[size]', \sprintf('The page size must be an integer from 1 to %d.', self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE));
        }

        return [$number, $size];
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $allowed the include paths the resource supports
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function includes(Request $request, array $allowed): array
    {
        $include = $request->query->get('include');
        if (null === $include) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!\is_string($include)) {
            throw new QueryParameterException('include', 'The include parameter must be a comma separated list of relationship paths.');
        }

        $paths = '' === $include ? [] : explode(',', $include);
        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            if (!\in_array($path, $allowed, true)) {
                throw new QueryParameterException('include', \sprintf('"%s" is not a relationship path that can be included.', $path));
            }
        }

        return $paths;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $fields sort field name => column expression
     *
     * @return list<array{string, 'ASC'|'DESC'}> column expression and direction, in the order given
     */
    public static function sort(Request $request, array $fields): array
    {
        $sort = $request->query->get('sort');
        if (null === $sort) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!\is_string($sort)) {
            throw new QueryParameterException('sort', 'The sort parameter must be a comma separated list of fields.');
        }

        $orders = [];
        foreach (explode(',', $sort) as $item) {
            $direction = 'ASC';
            $field = $item;
            if (str_starts_with($item, '-')) {
                $direction = 'DESC';
                $field = substr($item, 1);
            }
            if (!isset($fields[$field])) {
                throw new QueryParameterException('sort', \sprintf('"%s" is not a field that can be sorted on.', $item));
            }
            $orders[] = [$fields[$field], $direction];
        }

        return $orders;
    }

    /**
     * The value of a filter[...] key, or null when absent or empty.
     */
    public static function filter(Request $request, string $key): ?string
    {
        return self::string(self::family($request, 'filter'), $key, \sprintf('filter[%s]', $key));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function family(Request $request, string $name): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->all()[$name] ?? [];
        if (!\is_array($value)) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($name, \sprintf('The %s parameter is malformed.', $name));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    public static function date(string $parameter, string $value): \DateTimeImmutable
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $value, $matches) || !checkdate((int) $matches[2], (int) $matches[3], (int) $matches[1])) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($parameter, \sprintf('"%s" must be a date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.', $parameter));
        }

        return new \DateTimeImmutable($value, new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
    }

    public static function requiredDate(Request $request, string $name): \DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value || '' === $value) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($name, \sprintf('The %s parameter is required.', $name));
        }
        if (!\is_string($value)) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($name, \sprintf('The %s parameter must be a date.', $name));
        }

        return self::date($name, $value);
    }

    public static function boolean(string $parameter, string $value): bool
    {
        return match ($value) {
            'true' => true,
            'false' => false,
            default => throw new QueryParameterException($parameter, \sprintf('"%s" must be true or false.', $parameter)),
        };
    }

    public static function integerValue(string $parameter, string $value): int
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^-?\d{1,10}$/', $value)) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($parameter, \sprintf('"%s" must be an integer.', $parameter));
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    /**
     * The resource id of a path, or null when it cannot be a database id.
     */
    public static function id(string $id): ?int
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/', $id) || (int) $id > 2147483647) {
            return null;
        }

        return (int) $id;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $family
     */
    private static function integer(array $family, string $key, string $parameter): ?int
    {
        if (!\array_key_exists($key, $family)) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!\is_string($family[$key])) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($parameter, \sprintf('"%s" must be an integer.', $parameter));
        }

        return self::integerValue($parameter, $family[$key]);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $family
     */
    public static function string(array $family, string $key, string $parameter): ?string
    {
        if (!\array_key_exists($key, $family) || '' === $family[$key]) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!\is_string($family[$key])) {
            throw new QueryParameterException($parameter, \sprintf('"%s" must be a single value.', $parameter));
        }

        return $family[$key];
    }
}
